name: RM-1
description:
## Description

"A bulb-type control amplifier that Vivaridge announced as a single component for the first time.Control amplifier RM-1consists of an amplifier body RM-1and a power supply RM-2.A semiconductor circuit is used for the power supply and control system supporting the amplifier system, and a vacuum tube is used for the amplifier element.The main circuit configuration consists of a DC amplifier configuration using a servo loop, a CR phono equalizer, an absolute phase control, and a touch-sensing mute mechanism.The audio booster consists of 126DJ8(E88CC) balls.Equipped with a super sonic filter and a sub sonic filter.Mutual interference is suppressed by using a separate chassis for the power supply."
